newsitem.title: USA: J.P. Morgan /Lehman named in Bre-X suit- WSJ.
newsitem.headline: J.P. Morgan /Lehman named in Bre-X suit- WSJ.

text.p: Lehman Brothers Inc and J.P. Morgan & Co were named in a lawsuit seeking class action status filed by shareholders of Bre-X Minerals Ltd over the Wall Street firms' alleged role in Bre-X's Indonesian mining scandal, The Wall Street Journal said.
In Monday's electronic edition, The Journal said the suit, filed in a federal court in Texas, combines several earlier class action suits against Bre-X and several company officials.
The suit concerns the roles played by the two Wall Street firms in promoting the perception that Bre-X's gold discoveries in Indonesia were substantial, the article said.
Those reserves turned out to be an illusion caused by someone adding gold to Bre-X's rock samples, the paper said.
